name: Greenply Industries Ltd
title: Greenply Industries Ltd - 526797 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated core EBITDA margin 12% (+150bps YoY) on MDF operating leverage and price hikes of 4-10% from April, but part of the volume was channel stocking in late March and MDF capacity is still being added.

utilisation.quote: we have a very small capacity compared to the country. I think at full capacity, if we run our factory, we only can gain 8% market share.

capex.peers_comment: Some smaller MDF players shut; certain players' plans are starting construction or due to end by year end; no new major capacity announced beyond what is already announced.
capex.quote: I don't see any new major capacity being announced other than which is already announced. So that is a good sign.

triggers.label: MDF price hikes 5-10%, plywood 4-5%
triggers.quote: we implemented calibrated price increases of 5% and 10% effective from April. In the Plywood segment, the impact was relatively lower and the price revisions were in the range of 4% to 5%

triggers.label: Smaller players shut or distressed
triggers.quote: a lot of unorganized plywood players shut down, a lot of the smaller MDF players had issue
triggers.highlight: a lot of unorganized plywood players shut down

triggers.label: Channel stocking in late March
triggers.quote: there might be a little bit of the growth because of overstocking also and the stocking only happened in the second half of March
triggers.highlight: the stocking only happened in the second half of March

triggers.label: Debtor days up 3 days since Dec
triggers.quote: From December '25, we have gone up by 3 days.

triggers.label: MDF capex INR425cr, Odisha ply INR130cr
triggers.quote: INR425 crores was only on the MDF segment, out of which I think almost close to INR300 crores would be in the current FY
triggers.highlight: almost close to INR300 crores would be in the current FY

guidance.quote: We have set a volume 10% growth target for plywood backed by our strong brand equity.
In MDF, we are capitalizing on rising demand and confident in delivering 25% to 30% volume growth.
maybe for 1 year, we might peak out to maybe 0.7 or 0.72 debt/equity.
The Board of Directors has recommended a dividend at the rate 50%

prior_guidance_check.metric: H2 FY26 double-digit volume and value growth
prior_guidance_check.quote: Greenply Industries has successfully delivered on its H2 FY '26 guidance, achieving double -digit year -on-year growth in both volume and value
Our debt-to-equity ratio remains at 0.52, in line with our guided range of 0.5 to 0.6 for the year

red_flags.label: Income tax search and seizure at premises
red_flags.quote: a search and seizure operation was conducted by income tax department at certain business premises of the company from 26th February 2026 to 2nd March '26

red_flags.label: CEO/JMD resignation
red_flags.quote: Mr. Manoj Tulsian has submitted his resignation as JMD and CEO of the company.

red_flags.label: Dubai exposure impairment INR15.16 cr
red_flags.quote: We have disclosed a total of INR15.16 crores as an exceptional item representing impairments

red_flags.label: MDF gross margin volatility; trading losses
red_flags.quote: Initially in quarter 2 and quarter 3 to just service the market, we had to also buy MDF and sell MDF, which hardly had any gross margin

evasions.quote: it's very difficult to give you the latest update because in the last 2, 3 months, there's a lot changed
The reason is obviously not known to us that why this happened.
This is the reason of the product mix only.
